accounts_deposit_kind_ck.name: accounts_deposit_kind_ck
accounts_deposit_kind_ck.value: deposit_kind IS NULL OR (deposit_kind IN ('current', 'savings', 'fixed', 'other') AND account_type = 'bank')

accounts_number_hint_ck.name: accounts_number_hint_ck
accounts_number_hint_ck.value: number_hint IS NULL OR (length(number_hint) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND number_hint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Za-z]*')

accounts_dates_ck.name: accounts_dates_ck
accounts_dates_ck.value: closed_on IS NULL OR opened_on IS NULL OR closed_on >= opened_on

cards_expires_on_ck.name: cards_expires_on_ck
cards_expires_on_ck.value: expires_on IS NULL OR expires_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-0[1-9]' OR expires_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-1[0-2]'

institutions_country_ck.name: institutions_country_ck
institutions_country_ck.value: country IS NULL OR country GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z]'

ledger_idempotency_keys_key_ck.name: ledger_idempotency_keys_key_ck
ledger_idempotency_keys_key_ck.value: length(key) BETWEEN 16 AND 64 AND key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Za-z_-]*'

ledger_idempotency_keys_expires_ck.name: ledger_idempotency_keys_expires_ck
ledger_idempotency_keys_expires_ck.value: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > created_at

payment_channels_region_ck.name: payment_channels_region_ck
payment_channels_region_ck.value: region IS NULL OR region GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z]'

transaction_entries_amount_ck.name: transaction_entries_amount_ck
transaction_entries_amount_ck.value: amount IS NULL OR (typeof(amount) = 'integer' AND amount BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999)

transaction_events_reason_ck.name: transaction_events_reason_ck
transaction_events_reason_ck.value: (revision_kind <> 'original' OR correction_reason IS NULL) AND (revision_kind NOT IN ('fact_correction', 'snapshot_correction') OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL)

transaction_events_occurred_time_ck.name: transaction_events_occurred_time_ck
transaction_events_occurred_time_ck.value: occurred_time IS NULL OR occurred_time GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'

transaction_events_posted_on_ck.name: transaction_events_posted_on_ck
transaction_events_posted_on_ck.value: posted_on IS NULL OR posted_on >= occurred_on

transaction_events_currency_ck.name: transaction_events_currency_ck
transaction_events_currency_ck.value: event_currency IS NULL OR event_currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'

transaction_events_amount_ck.name: transaction_events_amount_ck
transaction_events_amount_ck.value: event_amount IS NULL OR (typeof(event_amount) = 'integer' AND event_amount BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999)

transaction_events_exponent_ck.name: transaction_events_exponent_ck
transaction_events_exponent_ck.value: event_currency_exponent IS NULL OR (typeof(event_currency_exponent) = 'integer' AND event_currency_exponent BETWEEN 0 AND 4)

transaction_events_amount_currency_ck.name: transaction_events_amount_currency_ck
transaction_events_amount_currency_ck.value: event_amount IS NULL OR event_currency IS NOT NULL

transaction_events_amount_required_ck.name: transaction_events_amount_required_ck
transaction_events_amount_required_ck.value: event_amount IS NOT NULL OR txn_type = 'third_party_transfer'

transaction_events_merchant_country_ck.name: transaction_events_merchant_country_ck
transaction_events_merchant_country_ck.value: merchant_country IS NULL OR merchant_country GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z]'

transaction_events_transfer_method_ck.name: transaction_events_transfer_method_ck
transaction_events_transfer_method_ck.value: transfer_method IS NULL OR transfer_method IN ('swift', 'sepa', 'fps', 'ach', 'local_transfer', 'internal_book', 'other')

transaction_events_counterparty_kind_ck.name: transaction_events_counterparty_kind_ck
transaction_events_counterparty_kind_ck.value: counterparty_kind IS NULL OR counterparty_kind IN ('self', 'third_party')

transaction_events_counterparty_country_.name: transaction_events_counterparty_country_ck
transaction_events_counterparty_country_.value: counterparty_country IS NULL OR counterparty_country GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z]'

transaction_events_counterparty_hint_ck.name: transaction_events_counterparty_hint_ck
transaction_events_counterparty_hint_ck.value: counterparty_account_hint IS NULL OR (length(counterparty_account_hint) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND counterparty_account_hint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Za-z]*')

transaction_events_home_region_source_ru.name: transaction_events_home_region_source_rule_ck
transaction_events_home_region_source_ru.value: (home_region_source <> 'preference_at_save' OR revision = 1) AND (home_region_source <> 'user_declared' OR (revision = 1 AND record_mode = 'backfill')) AND (home_region_source <> 'carried' OR revision > 1) AND (home_region_source <> 'user_corrected' OR (revision > 1 AND revision_kind = 'snapshot_correction'))

transaction_events_merchant_scope_ck.name: transaction_events_merchant_scope_ck
transaction_events_merchant_scope_ck.value: merchant_scope IS NULL OR merchant_scope IN ('foreign', 'domestic', 'unknown')

transaction_events_transfer_scope_ck.name: transaction_events_transfer_scope_ck
transaction_events_transfer_scope_ck.value: transfer_scope IS NULL OR transfer_scope IN ('outbound', 'inbound', 'foreign_cross_border', 'foreign_local', 'domestic_local', 'domestic_to_unknown', 'unknown_to_domestic', 'foreign_to_unknown', 'unknown_to_foreign')

transaction_events_merchant_shape_ck.name: transaction_events_merchant_shape_ck
transaction_events_merchant_shape_ck.value: txn_type NOT IN ('merchant_spend', 'merchant_refund') OR (transfer_method IS NULL AND counterparty_kind IS NULL AND counterparty_name IS NULL AND counterparty_country IS NULL AND counterparty_institution IS NULL AND counterparty_account_hint IS NULL AND merchant_scope IS NOT NULL AND transfer_scope IS NULL AND event_amount IS NOT NULL)

transaction_events_transfer_shape_ck.name: transaction_events_transfer_shape_ck
transaction_events_transfer_shape_ck.value: txn_type NOT IN ('own_transfer', 'third_party_transfer') OR (card_id IS NULL AND merchant_name IS NULL AND merchant_country IS NULL AND merchant_scope IS NULL AND transfer_scope IS NOT NULL AND counterparty_kind = CASE txn_type WHEN 'own_transfer' THEN 'self' ELSE 'third_party' END)

transaction_events_merchant_scope_rule_c.name: transaction_events_merchant_scope_rule_ck
transaction_events_merchant_scope_rule_c.value: merchant_scope IS NULL OR merchant_scope = CASE WHEN merchant_country IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN merchant_country = home_region THEN 'domestic' ELSE 'foreign' END
